title: Week 3 - Components of Cloud Security [ISYS 481 2W 26-FA1]
description: This week you are will learn about the Capital One Breach in your case study you will be writing. In the Capital One breach specifically this there is some debate on the responsibility of the cloud provider, versus the cloud consumer. Go find a service level agreement for a cloud service or select one of the examples and then answer the following questions to help relate it back to the risk of the cloud business model outside of the typical thought of security risks. * What are the aggregate losses/payment the cloud provider will give to the customer in case of an issue? * How much notice does the provider have to give if they want to terminate the agreement, and what are the implications of that? * Any other interesting pieces that you see? (Example Cloud Service Agreements) * [Azure] (https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/support/legal/subscription-agreement/) * [AWS] (https://aws.amazon.com/agreement/) * [Google GCP] (https://cloud.google.com/terms/service-terms ) * [Akamai] (https://www.akamai.com/content/dam/sdl-content/us/en/multimedia/documents/akamai/akamai-services-terms-of-use.pdf) Make your first discussion posting by Wednesday, with two substantive responses by Saturday. Additional research outside of the textbook may be necessary to provide responses to some questions. You must make an initial post before you are able to view the posts of your peers. To view the discussion board rubric, click the gear icon in the upper right corner and select "Show Rubric."

title: D3 - Careers in Computer Science [COSC 150 1W 26-FA1]
description: [facets of computer science including theoretical computer science, computer engineering, and applications] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/97939/files/26277304/preview?hidden=1) This week, we will discuss careers in Computer Science. title: Week 3 - Cloud Risks - Capital One Case Study [ISYS 481 2W 26-FA1]
description: Complete the assigned weekly reading and review the case study listed below. Respond to the questions below in a 4-6 page Word document. APA format is required, to include 12 point font ONLY using Times New Roman, and please ensure you see your syllabus for any additional writing requirements from your instructor. Assignments are worth 20 points each and will be graded on content, spelling, and grammar. You must use at least (2) external references to support your original positions outside of the text book. They are due Sunday by 11:59 pm. The goal of this assignment is to reflect upon a well-publicized public breach. There is an expectation you will investigate AWS standard architectures, best practices, and fully understand the scenario that happened from the wealth of information that has been publicly disclosed. ASSUMPTIONS ARE OK IN THIS (as not all details are known) BUT BE SURE TO NOTE THEM! Some References below attached but feel free to find your own! * [Capital 1_A Technical Analysis of the Capital One Cloud Misconfiguration Breach] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/98346/files/26295562?wrap=1) * [Capital 1_AWS_WebArchitecture] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/98346/files/26295565?wrap=1) * [Capital 1_ejj-io-capital-one] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/98346/files/26295548?wrap=1) * [Capital 1_Paige Thompson DOJ complaint] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/98346/files/26295559?wrap=1) * [Capital_1_Amazon Letter to Sen Wyden RE Consumer Data] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/98346/files/26295551?wrap=1) * Break down after you conduct your research the likely sequence of attack that happened in this scenario that lead to the breach. * Discuss the attack and preventive measures that should have been deployed from a technical perspective that would have limited or eliminated the risk. * Discuss if a major financial institution was in a better position than one in another industry segment to protect their cloud environments and why. * Would Capital One be better off in a physical data center – if so or if not, why and how? * Based on this scenario what do you think is the “root cause” of this breach * Discuss what liability the cloud provider holds in this scenario and why * Discuss the findings from the Federal Regulator and fine tied to failure of controls which placed the blame at Capital One internal audit and finance footstep. Was that appropriate? 8. Conclude and summarize your personal thoughts on the scenario and what if anything you learned.

title: D4 - Crash Course: Computer Science [COSC 150 1W 26-FA1]
description: [Crash Course video thumbnail] (https://maryville.instructure.com/courses/97939/files/26277309/preview?hidden=1) Crash Course is a YouTube channel that publishes informational videos in a wide range of areas. The videos are short (10 to 15 minutes) and do not go into a great deal of depth about the topics they discuss, but they are a good way to learn a little about a topic that you don't know much about. This makes Crash Course a really good starting point for learning about a new topic. The [Course Course: Computer Science] (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL8dPuuaLjXtNlUrzyH5r6jN9ulIgZBpdo) series consists of 41 videos split into broad topics: * The Mechanics of How Computers Work * The Basics of Programming and Software * Computer Hardware * The Rise of Personal Computers and Graphics * The Internet * Artificial Intelligence * Humans and the Future of Computing Visit the link above and select THREE videos from the playlist to kickstart your thinking for the following: * For ONE of the videos you selected, post a brief summary - include your own thoughts on the subject addressed. After doing some additional reading on the subject: * Share an article, infographic, or video/podcast that explores the topic more deeply. We'll devote this time at the end of the week to exploring our interests within the field. Discussion Expectations Each week, you will be given a new discussion prompt. You will be expected to respond to this prompt (1-2) by 11:59 pm CST, Thursday, and will also be asked to reply to at least two of your classmates' posts by 11:59 pm CST, Sunday. You must make an initial post before you are able to view the posts of your peers.

title: D5 - Object Oriented Programming [COSC 150 1W 26-FA1]
description: [Object-oriented programming] (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Object-oriented_programming) (OOP) is a [programming paradigm] (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Programming_paradigm) that is based on the idea of bundling together values and functions into custom objects. It is an important concept that every computer programmer should be familiar with. Search the internet for resources discussing object-oriented programming, and then write a post in this thread with further information about this concept. Your post can consist of any of the following items: * A more detailed description of exactly what OOP is. * A discussion of topics related to OOP. * A discussion of the advantages and disadvantages of OOP. * Comments about the history of OOP, along with examples of languages that do and do not follow this paradigm. * A discussion of how this concept relates to Java. * Anything else that you find relevant to a discussion about OOP. Please post a link to at least one OOP resource that you found online. Discussion Expectations Each week, you will be given a new discussion prompt. You will be expected to respond to this prompt by 11:59 pm CST, Thursday, and will also be asked to reply to at least two of your classmates' posts by 11:59 pm CST, Sunday. You must make an initial post before you are able to view the posts of your peers.
